<b class=\"text-neutral-900\">이 등급을 받으면.en: With this level › you will tie together the prophecies of Daniel and Revelation, the Millennial Kingdom, and world affairs in the end times, so you can read the times and awaken others as a ‘watchman of the Word’ — the completion of “Reading the Times through the Word.”

With this level › you will study texts such as Romans and Leviticus in depth, organize the core doctrines of the Christian faith systematically, and become a ‘searcher of the Word’ who can teach and lead others in what you have learned.

With this level › you will know clearly the gospel, salvation and who Jesus Christ is, and become a ‘Christian who stands on his own feet’ — able to open and read the Bible and pray on your own, with the basics of church life in place.

With this level › you will grasp the flow of the whole Bible, answer common questions for yourself, and become a ‘maturing disciple’ who actually lives out the truth you have learned in relationships and in life's hardships.

With this level › armed with a biblical worldview, you will accurately discern heresies, cults and the lies of our age, and become a ‘person of steady discernment’ who can sift truth from error in culture and ideas.
